sheet_log.title: EXTERIOR ELEVATIONS - OPTION 01
sheet_log.scale: 1" = 59'-0" (Overall West Elevation); 1" = 49'-0" (Overall South Elevation); 1" = 29'-0" (Overall East Elevation); 1" = 49'-0" (Overall North Elevation)
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-201 contains four exterior building elevations (North, South, East, West) for an industrial building for Crow Holdings, located in Bartow County, Georgia. Elevations are at various scales making precise linear dimension extraction difficult at this resolution. Key elevation heights noted: TI Panel at Entry 44'-2", TI Panel 42'-2", Finish Floor 0'-1", Truck Court -4'-0" - consistent across all four elevations. Glass Schedule lists three glass types (A, B, C). Exterior Finish Schedule lists five finish types (101-104, 005). Downspouts, scuppers, coping are pre-finished metal. Storefront by Kawneer clear anodized. Two canopy types noted: red metal ACM and bullnose. All glazing referenced to be tempered per General Notes. This drawing is marked NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION and is at 95% design review stage per print record. Quantity counts for dock doors, windows, storefront areas, and canopy quantities require larger-scale drawings or plan sheets for accurate take-off.

sheet_log.title: MISC. DETAILS
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-401 is a miscellaneous details sheet for Crow Holdings Industrial - Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia. Contains 13 detail bubbles (numbered 1-13) all on sheet A-401. Key details include: typical bollard (Det.7), fire riser/electrical panel protection with bollards (Det.11), enlarged ramp plan (Det.13), ramp w/landing section (Det.12), ramp rail section (Det.4), stair plan/section/rail (Det.6/8/10), Z-guard detail (Det.9), pump/electrical room section (Det.5), and future dock leveler plan/sections (Det.1/2/3). Specific counts of bollards, lintels, and treads are not quantified on this sheet - those would be found on floor plans. Sheet status: NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION.
